fill_reason.pin_bound: E 495 out / W 297 in on M4 at 2 tracks over 101.52 um = 48%/29% of slots; N 79 on M5 over 23.76 = 35%; outline from measured-util resize (FLOORPLAN_MARGIN 71.6% at 21.6x88.56).

job.purpose: hard_v5 COLL q2 qslots 32-bit switch slice (NS9 ND15), 17x in q2; every output a flop Q.

pin_regs.reason: Actual RTL already registers every port at the face: qslots_output captures captured/captured_slot/sink_slot/sink_select into _p flops before any logic; dst_v/dst_d/select_fault/unavailable_fault are flop Q. Recipe-2 output stage on: io_flop_at_pins anchors only the OUTPUT launch flops at their pins (OT_OFLOP_PORT_RE), pin_reg_split + keep_pin_regs give one launch flop per output pin; inputs keep their inhold pad.

structural_change: Loop verdict hcoll_v5_qso2w-qs1045-f16932251 FLOORPLAN_MARGIN: flow std 1043 um2 = util 71.6% in 21.6x88.56 (gate synth 818 under-estimated by 1.28x); area x1.30 at the same aspect -> 23.76x101.52, core 1890 um2 = 55% at the measured std; same RTL, pin faces, recipe. Plus the recipe-2 output stage (io_flop_at_pins on outputs only, pin_reg_split, keep_pin_regs, balanced pins) so dst launch meets the native 220-ps budget (qcap twin failed launch 240.4 without it).
